verdict.rationale: Exa's core interfaces take natural-language input directly. Search accepts a natural-language query, Websets start from a natural-language request, and Exa Agent runs multi-step research. The hosted MCP server lets users drive search, fetching and agent runs conversationally from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar tools without writing code. Hands-on reports show natural-language Websets queries work, though with mixed precision. Missing for 10: no evidence of natural-language control over account or admin operations (keys, billing, limits), and independent reports show uneven fidelity in how natural-language criteria are interpreted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Exa Search is a web search API that takes a natural language query and returns ranked web results with clean page content.
A Webset starts with a natural-language query and a target item count.
Tool-using agents can call Exa without writing code through the hosted MCP server at https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp
the `agent_run` tool is enabled by default, so you can run multi-step research, list-building, enrichment, and structured output from Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients.
